title: Division notation variants
note: Division has many faces: a÷b = a/b = a·(1/b) = a·b⁻¹. All the same object.

title: Fraction as multiplication by a reciprocal
note: Dividing by b is multiplying by 1/b: a/b = a·(1/b). This is why dividing by a fraction means multiplying by its reciprocal.

title: Dividing by 1
note: Dividing by 1 changes nothing: a/1 = a.

title: Splitting a fraction over addition
note: You may split a sum in the numerator: (a+b)/c = a/c + b/c. You may NOT split the denominator: a/(b+c) is not a/b + a/c.
